about_the_game:
• Snake Eyes is a bullet hell top down 2D rougelike where you assume the role of a vengeful snake on a quest to take down the casino that took her arm. Using her homemade Slot Machine Gun, she'll parry, dodge, and blast her way through the Snake Eyes Casino while finding unique items to assist her on the path of vengeance. Shoot your way through the streets, game rooms, and VIP lounges of the Snake Eyes Casino with an array of unique bullets and items.

  • Utilize your Slot Machine Gun, a unique gun that relies on slot machine logic to provide your ammunition. One reload may spin you a shotgun shell, sniper round, and a shuriken. While the next may give a flamethrower, piranha, and baseball bat. Your playstyle will be forced to rapidly adjust as each bullet requires different strategy to make effective. If you are lucky enough, you may even spin a Jackpot and unleash the devastating power of an extreme version of the base bullet.

  • Along your quest you may find unique items that will fine tune a unique playstyle each run. One run may give you items dropping mines with each dodge roll, while another may provide items that create sentries whenever you parry. The possibilities are immense!

  • Unleash hell upon the Snake Eyes Mafia that seeks to end your crusade. Whether it be dogs, penguins, or fellow snakes, they will stop at nothing to put an end to your rampage. Each of them utilizing unique weapons to try and put you down.

  • Fight through three tumultuous levels. Beginning in the slums outside the casino, the glamorous iced casino floor, and finally the climactic showdown in the prestigious VIP lounge.

  • Gamble on revenge in Snake Eyes!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Anything with windows
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 1 MB RAM
  • Graphics: can it run doom?
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Preferably have a computer capable of playing sounds
  • Additional Notes: (Essentially any windows-based computer will work)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Once again, anything with windows
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 20 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Anything in the last 10 years
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: If your computer can have sound then this game will work
  • Additional Notes: (Essentially any windows-based computer will work)

short_description: Snake Eyes is a bullet hell top down 2D roguelike where you assume the role of a vengeful snake on a quest to take down the casino that took her arm. Parry, dodge, and take revenge with your homemade Slot Machine Gun while collecting unique items to assist you on your path of revenge.
